The '''Dakata spaceport''' was a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Simbarc]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was known to host a casino. In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] visited the spaceport while seeking to pay a debt to the gangster [[Sollima]].
